questions.question: What does investing generally mean?
options: Putting money into assets with the goal of earning a return
questions.explanation: Investing involves putting money into assets with the expectation of generating returns over time.

questions.question: What is investment risk?
options: The possibility that an investment may lose value or produce a lower-than-expected return
A guarantee that an investment will make money
The amount of cash in your wallet
questions.explanation: Investment risk is the possibility of losing value or receiving a different return than expected.

questions.question: Why can diversification be useful?
options: It can spread investments across different assets
It guarantees that every investment will make money
questions.explanation: Diversification spreads money across different investments and can reduce dependence on a single investment.

questions.question: What is a stock?
options: A unit representing ownership in a company
questions.explanation: A stock generally represents a share of ownership in a company.

questions.question: Why is a longer investment time horizon often relevant when investing?
options: It can provide more time for investments to grow and for short-term fluctuations to occur
It guarantees that there will be no losses
questions.explanation: A longer time horizon can give investments more time to potentially grow and can provide more time to withstand short-term market fluctuations.
